about: Owner Billing's O2b (to-dos/gc-mode/OWNER_BILLING_REAL_BUILD.md, Kernels): the rest of billing the customer, now that the Building lane's kernels it reads are on main (U2), lifted to src/lib/gc on a spike that reads O2a from main. timeExtension and lateFinish go in src/lib/gc/, never schedule/ (billing reads the schedule, never the other way). payAppFile.ts takes the cells; the Excel and PDF writers wait for O4a.
